fields.description: The Orchids is Aldar’s gated townhouse and villa release within Yas Acres on Yas Island. Its family homes combine private gardens with access to community facilities, while the initial townhouse launch and later villa release need to be considered separately.

overview: Aldar’s announcement describes a 500 sq m community club with gym and multipurpose space, supported by a park, pools and sports facilities. The established Yas Acres setting also places schools and retail within the wider neighbourhood.

The reviewed townhouse drawings arrange living areas on the ground floor and bedrooms upstairs, with private gardens and two illustrated parking spaces. The three-bedroom end layout includes a ground-floor multipurpose room. Final plot boundaries and fit-out must be checked for the selected home.
research.locationNote: Within Yas Acres on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. Wider island leisure destinations and Yas Acres Golf & Country Club are nearby; membership, school places and access terms are separate matters.
research.priceNote: Launch townhouse prices: AED 3.35m for two-bedroom middle, AED 3.67m for three-bedroom middle and AED 3.95m for three-bedroom end homes. Aldar reported the townhouse launch sold out on 26 June 2026; current resale terms require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The 5% booking payment forms part of the 55% pre-handover amount. A further 50% is paid during construction and 45% at handover; dated instalments require a current offer.
research.handoverNote: The presentation and broker estimate Q3 2030. Confirm contractual completion and possession terms.
